_about: Layer 2 (product line) and layer 3 (series) of Cisco HyperFlex, 14 Sep 2026; reviewed in layers round 3 (15 Sep 2026). Nodes by model (HX220c, HX225c, HX240c, HX245c; hybrid, All Flash HXAF and All NVMe variants of one model sit together), Edge and Express, compute-only nodes, fabric interconnects and bundles; a component whose SKU names a node platform (HX-RIS-2A-240M5, CBL-SATA-C220M6) sits with that node, any other HX- component in 'HyperFlex shared parts'. Compute-only nodes (HX-C220 / HX-C240 / HX-C480 / HX-B200) come first: their SKUs carry the same platform tokens. No role axis.

lines.no_family_reason: Cisco names the HX220c / HX225c / HX240c / HX245c nodes, HyperFlex Edge, HyperFlex Express, the compute-only nodes, the fabric interconnects and the starter bundles under HyperFlex, with no family between

^UCS-HX-(UC-)?FI (layers round 3): UCS-HX-FI48P / FI96P / UC-FI48P, planned in from servers-unified-computing. ^HX-DH-FI (same round): HX-DH-FI6332-16UP 'HX SAP Datahub FI3232UP …' sat in HyperFlex shared parts (a fabric interconnect in shared parts)

^UCS-SEED-HX (layers round 3): UCS-SEED-HX220 / HX240, planned in from servers-unified-computing. ^HX(AF)?-M[0-9]S-HXDP, ^HX2X0C- and ^HX-M[0-9]-MLB (same round): the system PIDs that order a HyperFlex cluster — HX-M5S-HXDP / HXAF-M5S-HXDP 'Cisco HX(AF)2X0C M5 Hyperflex System', HX2X0C-M4S / -M5S 'Cisco Hyperconverged System' and their successor HX-M6-MLB 'HX/HXAF/EDG M6 MLB' — sat in HyperFlex shared parts, the first six with kind server. HX-M4S-HXDP carries an earlier class plan to software (kind layer), which this round did not re-read
